_comment: NSID authority: atproto.music (owned, per Torsten — 2026-09-01). One record per note-on event, published by whichever device/app played it — hardware synth (ESP8266/ESP32 WiFi-native, or Arduino UNO via an OpenWrt tty<>net bridge) or the on-screen-keyboard web app, all through station-5-synth/relay/synth_relay.py. Modeled on station-2's science.iosp.sensor.reading.json — same no-floats rule (AT Protocol's on-wire record model has no floating-point type; every fx amount here is an integer 0-100, not a fraction).

main.description: A single note-on event from a Mozzi-based synth or the web on-screen keyboard, shared live across the network.

deviceId.description: Free-form identifier for the physical device or app instance that played this, e.g. 'esp32-a', 'uno-bridge-1', 'webkeys-torsten'.

synthType.description: Which synth patch/hardware variant produced this, e.g. 'mozzi-esp32-fm', 'mozzi-uno-am', 'webaudio-keys'.

fxType.description: Optional Mozzi effect active on this note, e.g. 'tremolo', 'reverb', 'delay', 'none'.

fxAmount.description: Effect intensity as a percentage (no floats on the wire — see _comment).

cutoffHz.description: Optional filter cutoff frequency in Hz, if the patch exposes a filter control.

createdAt.description: ATProto-compatible UTC timestamp — use atproto_helpers.get_atproto_utc_time() (relay/), not nebra's — see that module's docstring.
